settings.question: What is the design studio?
settings.answer: A way to build a piece to your own specification - the setting, the stone and the metal - and see it priced before you order. Every piece is then made to order for you.

settings.question: Do I need to know what I want before I start?
settings.answer: No. Start anywhere - a shape you like, a budget, a photo - and change it as many times as you need. Nothing is cut or cast until you approve the design.

settings.question: What can I design?
settings.answer: Engagement rings, wedding and eternity bands, and made-to-order necklaces, earrings and bracelets. If what you have in mind is not on this page, ask us.

settings.question: What does it cost?
settings.answer: The studio prices every change as you make it, so you always see the number before you commit. A design that starts from scratch is quoted once we have the drawing.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Making begins once you have approved the design and the quote. We confirm the date in writing with your quote, so you know before you pay.

settings.question: Can someone help me while I design?
settings.answer: Yes. Get in touch at any point and one of our designers will go through the options with you.
